scope: Oakland only; presentation geography. Existing URLs, canonical associations, engines and content stay owned by existing records.
coordinatePolicy: Existing Rofo area points are approximate orientation references with no measured accuracy; decimal places do not imply precision. Property positions are dated Census address-range interpolation, not parcel, suite or entrance verification. No default city-center points or invented boundaries.
reuse: Original factual review notes and source links only. Census geometry/geocoder output is government open data. City/BID PDF images, design, listing text and photography are not republished.
